name: plot_maker
description: Draw a line, scatter or bar chart as a PNG in the workspace plots folder. Give numbers directly (x and series) or point at a CSV file in the workspace.

x.description: X values (numbers; bar charts may use text labels)

series.description: Map of series name to list of Y numbers, same length as x

csv_path.description: CSV file inside the workspace, with a header row

x_column.description: CSV column for x (default: first column)

y_columns.description: CSV columns to plot (default: all others)

filename.description: Output name without folder; saved under plots/
